external_collaboration.partner_name: Swiss Coordination Center for Research in Education (SCCRE)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Swiss Coordination Center for Research in Education (SCCRE) was founded in 1971 and is a joint institution of the Federal Authorities of the Swiss Confederation and the Swiss Conference of Cantonal Ministers of Education (EDK). It documents Swiss research on education, coordinates opportunities for dialogue between researchers, administrators and policymakers, and issues Switzerland’s report on education, which comes out every four years.
